scenarios.name: Krark copies the instant you cast when you win the flip
scenarios.ruling: Winning the flip copies the spell on the stack. The copy is created on the stack and resolves before the original, so Lightning Bolt deals its 3 damage twice.

expect.log: flips a coin for Krark, the Thumbless: heads \(wins the flip\)

scenarios.name: Krark returns the spell to its owner's hand when you lose the flip
scenarios.ruling: Losing the flip moves the spell from the stack to its owner's hand, so it never resolves and deals no damage. The engine's flip sequence loses for the first time on the sixth flip of the game, so the first five Shocks are copied (2 + 2 damage each, 20 in total) and the sixth is returned to hand.

expect.log: flips a coin for Krark, the Thumbless: tails \(loses the flip\)

scenarios.name: Krark's ability does not trigger when you cast a creature spell
scenarios.ruling: The ability triggers only on an instant or sorcery spell, so a creature spell is neither copied nor returned to its owner's hand.

scenarios.ruling: Partner is a printed keyword ability of Krark, the Thumbless.
